description:
An actor at the peak of his fame exits Hollywood's glitzy stardom in exchange for his soul's salvation. He is best known for his roles as Quincy in HBO's Ballers, Wells Jaha in the post-apocalyptic drama show “The 100,” and Cassius Clay in the biographical film “One Night in Miami.” Tune in to hear Eli Goreé's story.
